title: Contact episode
description: A period of sustained Bluetooth proximity between the observing participant and one peer, aggregated on-device. Carried as the `payload` of an Epidemica observation envelope. Raw RSSI samples are NOT uploaded by default: the on-device estimator reduces them to time-in-distance-band, which is both the epidemiologically meaningful quantity and a large reduction in volume and re-identification risk.

peer.description: Pseudonym of the other participant. Never a device address or PII.

pair_key.description: SHA-256 of the two pseudonyms sorted lexicographically and joined with a NUL byte. Lets the server reconcile the two independent recordings of the same encounter without knowing which participant is which.

band_seconds.description: Seconds of the episode spent in each distance band. This, not a mean distance, is the primary measurement: infectious dose accumulates as duration x f(distance), so a 2-minute immediate contact plus 8 minutes far is epidemiologically unlike 10 minutes at medium range, yet both average the same.

band_edges_m.description: Upper edges in metres of the first three bands; `far` is unbounded. Recorded inline so the observation stays self-describing if the estimator's banding changes, which is what makes datasets poolable across app versions and studies.

min_distance_m.description: Closest estimated approach during the episode.

sample_count.description: Number of RSSI samples underlying the estimate. Low counts over long episodes indicate a sparse, less reliable episode.

gap_count.description: Number of detection dropouts bridged when merging detections into this episode. Essential for judging reliability: an episode assembled across many gaps is weaker evidence than a continuously observed one.

rssi.description: Optional summary retained for estimator calibration and for the Aim 2 network-fidelity work. Omitted in minimal-collection studies.

estimator.description: Identifier of the on-device distance estimator, e.g. 'coarse_distance'.

estimator_version.description: Semantic version of the estimator. Together with band_edges_m this makes the measurement reproducible and re-derivable.

truncated.description: True when the episode was cut at the app's maximum episode length rather than because proximity ended. Apps SHOULD split long encounters (recommended maximum 900 s) so that replay into a simulation timestep needs little temporal apportionment.

deviceClass.description: RSSI-to-distance mapping is device-dependent, so both sides' hardware class is required to interpret or re-derive the estimate.
